title: Reset your password
text: Use the Forgot password link on the sign in page. The reset email arrives within 5 minutes; check spam. Links expire after 1 hour.

title: Shipping times
text: Standard shipping takes 3 to 7 business days. Tracking is emailed when the order ships. Delays over 10 days are investigated.

title: Refund policy
text: Refund requests are reviewed by our billing team within 3 business days. Eligibility depends on order date and item condition.

title: Duplicate charges
text: A pending authorization can appear twice and drops off in 3 to 5 days. Settled duplicate charges are reviewed by billing.

title: App crashes on launch
text: Update to the latest version, restart the device, then reinstall if the crash continues. Include the app version and device model when contacting support.

title: Two factor authentication
text: If you lost your second factor, verify identity with a recovery code or contact support to start a verified reset.
